issues.display_title: Issue #4370: feat(billing): dunning notification banner and subscription status modal update
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Subscribers whose card renewals fail are currently unaware of the issue because no warnings are shown on the dashboard, and the subscription modal still shows them as fully active.

Scope of Work

  • Sidebar Alert: Display a persistent warning box in the left sidebar navigation: "⚠️ Payment Failed. We couldn't process your subscription renewal..." with an action button to update payment.
  • Subscription Status Modal: Update the description to indicate overdue renewal, hide the Upgrade and Downgrade buttons, and provide a single [Go to Billing] button.
  • Manual Invoice Guidance: For legacy manual-invoice accounts, guide users to [Contact Support] instead of self-service card input.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Overdue subscribers see the warning banner on the sidebar immediately upon login.
  • Opening Subscription Status modal clearly indicates renewal failure and disables Upgrade/Downgrade buttons.
  • Manual invoice accounts are directed to Support.

Demo

issues.display_title: Issue #4372: feat(billing): billing recovery and instant feature restoration on card update
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

When a user updates their payment method to settle an overdue renewal, the interface should provide clear real-time feedback and instantly restore full access without requiring a manual page refresh.

Scope of Work

  • Connect the [Go to Billing] and [Update Payment] buttons directly to the billing information and card update dialog.
  • Handle real-time card payment outcomes:
    • If payment succeeds: show success message, close modal, instantly remove dunning banners, and unlock all paid features.
    • If card is declined: keep modal open and display the bank decline reason clearly in red text.
  • Automatically refresh global subscription state upon successful payment.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Clicking payment buttons opens the billing card update modal seamlessly.
  • Successful card update immediately clears dunning status and unlocks all features without delay.
  • Declined cards show clear feedback to the user inside the modal.

issues.display_title: Issue #4371: feat(billing): feature gating interceptor for overdue subscriptions
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Subscribers with overdue payments can currently continue using paid compute-heavy features (publishing virtual tours to Google Street View, generating videos, AI tools) without paying, causing infrastructure cost leakage.

Scope of Work

  • Temporarily lock paid subscriber features when an account is in an overdue payment state:
    • Google Street View & Blue Line publishing
    • Walkthrough & 360 Video creation
    • AI automated tools (auto-leveling, blurring, patching)
    • Offline tour downloads and analytics
    • Sub-accounts management and custom branding
  • Whenever an overdue user attempts any of these actions, show an overdue payment reminder dialog ("🚨 Your Renewal Payment Is Overdue") with a button to proceed to billing.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Attempting to publish or use any paid feature is blocked while the subscription is overdue.
  • Clicking any blocked action opens the overdue payment reminder dialog.
  • Non-paid actions and regular tour browsing remain accessible.

Demo

issues.display_title: Issue #4380: feat(billing): block plan changes and space add-on purchases during dunning
issues.main_description_html:
Background

While a user's subscription is in dunning (past_due / unpaid after a failed renewal
payment), paid features are already gated via useDunningGate. However, the subscription
plan-change flows are not gated: a past-due user can still open the payment form to
upgrade/downgrade or buy a storage add-on, and only gets a raw backend error after submitting
(the backend rejects non-active subscriptions in getStripeSubscriptionDetail).

Goal

Block subscription plan changes and storage add-on purchases on the dashboard while the
subscription is past due, and direct the user to settle the overdue payment first via the
existing global dunning modal ("Update Payment Method").

Scope

  • src/pages/Profile/Subscription/Subscription.jsx
    • handleSubscribe: plan card Upgrade / Downgrade
    • handleUpgradeAgencyPlan: extra storage card "Upgrade Now"
    • handleBuySpaceAddon: space add-on "Buy Now"
  • src/components/organism/PaymentV2/Unsubscribe.jsx
    • handleDowngradeToBasic: "downgrade to BASIC" link inside the Unsubscribe modal

Out of Scope

  • Unsubscribing (cancel) remains allowed during dunning.
  • New subscriptions for pay-as-you-go users are not gated.
  • Backend guard / clearer API error message for upgrade, downgrade and space add-on (may be
    handled in a separate backend issue later).

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: A past-due user clicking Upgrade or Downgrade on a plan card sees the dunning modal; the payment form and the downgrade warning modal do not open.
  • AC-002: A past-due user clicking "Upgrade Now" on the extra storage card sees the dunning modal; the payment form does not open.
  • AC-003: A past-due Agency / Sub Account user clicking "Buy Now" on the space add-on sees the dunning modal; the payment form does not open.
  • AC-004: A past-due user clicking the BASIC downgrade link in the Unsubscribe modal sees the Unsubscribe modal close and the dunning modal open.
  • AC-005: Users whose subscription is not past due keep the existing behavior for all flows above.
  • AC-006: Unit tests cover AC-001 – AC-004.

Related

  • Implementation PR: #4378 (also re-enables the dunning gate, reverting the temporary disable in #4376)
  • Backend: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#2065 (auto-pay of past-due invoices on card update)

Result

Implementation

  • PR: #4378 — merged into development on 2026-10-13 (merge commit 0fcefb3)
  • Key commits:
    • f75f918 — feat(billing): block plan changes and space add-on purchases during dunning
    • 6602501 — feat(billing): re-enable dunning feature gating and warning banners (prerequisite: removes the ENABLE_DUNNING_GATE flag so isPastDue is active)
  • Behavior: when isPastDue, plan card Upgrade/Downgrade, extra storage "Upgrade Now", space add-on "Buy Now", and the Unsubscribe modal's BASIC downgrade link open the global dunning modal instead of the payment form. Unsubscribing and pay-as-you-go new subscriptions are not gated.

Testing

  • CI=true npx craco test --watchAll=false src/pages/Profile/Subscription src/components/organism/PaymentV2/Unsubscribe.test.jsx src/hooks/useDunningGate.test.jsx → 4 suites, 23/23 passed
    • 5 new tests: past-due Upgrade (AC-001), Downgrade (AC-001), extra storage Upgrade Now (AC-002), space add-on Buy Now (AC-003), Unsubscribe → BASIC downgrade (AC-004)
    • Existing Subscription / Unsubscribe / Countly tests still pass with isPastDue = false (AC-005)
  • Affected users (live Stripe, read-only check 2026-10-13 08:49 UTC): 54 users currently past_due (all USD, charge_automatically)
